propositions: BindingStore facade must delegate load/save and unit-of-work persistence to BindingRepository without changing public imports, signatures, or exception behavior
Existing pending, confirmed, and reverse lookup behavior plus shallow all_bindings() must survive after repository extraction
BindingRepository persistence must produce byte-identical output and preserve exception semantics versus the original facade implementation
Repository injection behind the facade must not expose writable repository to callers or alter peer_state and rotation ownership
Legacy format handling and best-effort alert semantics must be retained when removing dead persistence code
Facade refactoring must pass existing regression tests for GET-rotation and retired-commit behavior
